The '''Methane Fix Cantina''' was a dining establishment in the [[spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine]]. It was located on [[Dune Street]], next door to the wreckage of the ''[[Dowager Queen]]''.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

[[File:MethaneFixCantina.jpg|thumb|left|170px|The Methane Fix Cantina.]]
